# Chapter12 / ART-20 finite contract

## Ownership

Chapter12 Layer A selects all four canonical documents and owns the supplied ART-20 ID graph, evidence binding, parent non-execution boundary, Source/route/index ownership and exact projected Case parity. Layer B is only `publication_projection.py` 1.1.0 with the locked renderer. Layer C is only Content Safety Policy1.2.0. No Chapter12 Markdown/HTML/URL/credential parser exists.

`chapter12_semantics.py` compares the finite supplied record. It is not an IAM engine, OAuth/Assertion validator, authentication client, secret recognizer or arbitrary path search. The closed schema accepts only supplied vocabulary (with explicit finite state/method/condition alternatives); unknown fields and unregistered strings fail closed. This intentionally is not an interchange format or automatic grader for arbitrary student Graphs.

## Finite positive and negative families

- FourPrincipal/sixPathstates/threeMethods, MFA changes without a path-state change, tighter budgets, conservative conclusions.
- Typed and continuous necessary Edge chain, permission/resource/action, separate issuer/audience/RP, same graph/policy revision and complete input conditions.
- Static review cannot validate; authored events do not authorize; known necessary denial versus unknown; unrelated edge denial cannot refute this path; no global reachability claim.
- Federation comparisons require all three assertion identifiers; non-Federation comparisons require explicit null fields (not an Unknown condition). CH12-FED-APPLICABILITY tests cover canonical/mixed/full-null and non-applicable forged tuples at schema, model and kernel boundaries.
- Chapter12 Source reader impact must remain in CHANGELOG (CH12-CHANGELOG); this does not rewrite historical entries.
- Same-path config/event/evaluation Evidence, recomputed expectation/actual/refuted edge, no borrowing or unowned evidence.
- Closed unknown/missing fields and unregistered values across every supplied object/leaf; duplicate JSON keys, UTF-8, nonstandard constants, exact timestamps.
- Parent Draft/expiry/original window/three objects/false, unknown binding/Coverage, record-only candidate and independent Chapter11 unchanged.
- Four complete documents through shared projection, required semantic fields, preamble/body/tail direct unsafe mutations and safe prohibition counterpart, heading drift and shared unsupported diagnostic.
- Exact Source token ownership in body/reference; five exercise blocks precede commands. Every visible Case leaf is compared with the JSON independently of repeated Policy scans.
- Bounded 1MiB regular files, nofollow/ancestor symlink/FIFO/empty/unknown path rejection, fixed publication-preflight command order and UTF-8 I/O.

Tests are a finite traversal of supplied shapes and explicit semantic counterexamples, not an unbounded fuzz grammar. Run with PYTHONHASHSEED0/1/7/42; the generic renderer corpus remains shared and is not duplicated here.

## Exact provenance exemptions

The frozen publication contract contains eight nonoperative analytic fields: three manuscript fields (explicit non-goals/Token nonimplementation/safety prerequisites), three template fields (nonoperative class-only wording/zero attempts/class inventory), and two Source Note scope limitations. Nineteen exact host relations cover verified official/delegated destinations, the repository-local command, and section-number false positives. No credential material or real-target operation is exempted.

Every exemption binds document, typed field, exact text, heading path, exactly-once cardinality and, for destinations, its visible owner. Mutation, relocation, duplication or removal fails closed with the exact missing/duplicate identity in the diagnostic. Exemptions are reviewed canonical context, not domain allowlists or new Layer C grammar. New prose does not inherit them.

## Publication and limits

`npm run check:chapter12` runs the complete finite corpus. `sync:docs` invokes the no-regressions canonical check before deleting/regenerating docs; actual preflight negative tests are also run in a disposable workspace-local worktree during publication verification. Existing parent manuscript/JSON, shared Policy/Projection, locks and formatter pin remain frozen by digest. Only prior finite command inventories are extended for the new consumer.

The JSON and Case are authored synthetic assumptions. A matching comparison is not a real authentication result, measured isolation, legal approval, completed cleanup, parent Gap closure or tested Detection. Handoffs remain planned-not-delivered; all execution flags remain false.
